condition: Epigastric pain to the back: lipase before imaging
summary: 45-year-old man with epigastric pain through to the back after a weekend of heavy drinking; no bloods yet.

inputs.hpi: Constant epigastric pain radiating through to the back since last night, with vomiting, after a weekend of heavy drinking.

mustInclude.note: Serum lipase / amylase (> 3 x ULN) is the cheap discriminating test for acute pancreatitis (revised Atlanta; ACG 2024); CT is not needed for the diagnosis.

mustExclude.note: No can't-miss diagnosis among the leading three: no CT, MRI or endoscopy as the next discriminator.

guideline.name: Classification of acute pancreatitis — revised Atlanta classification

rationale: The best next discriminator should be the bedside/lab test that separates pancreatitis from peptic disease, not a scan.
